acceptance: AGENTS.md 'Release pin' states the hazard and the remedy (after merging, restore next's version of each page main removed text from, unless the removal is a correction that also applies on develop)
The next-behind-main issue body lists docs files where the merge would delete lines from next, computed without writing a ref, with a test of the script against a scratch repository
No change to merge permissions, rulesets or the reminder's no-push design
Decision recorded: whether a checklist line in the issue is enough or the list of files is needed
context: Found 2026-11-14 while merging main into next after pull request #160. Guardrails: the workflow stays read-only on branches; do not auto-restore text; goes to main, then main is merged into next.
description:
Problem: when a correction on main removes text that describes unreleased behaviour, the following merge of main into next applies the same removal to next without a conflict, because next still held that text unchanged. The unreleased documentation then silently disappears from next and from the next release. On 2026-11-14 the merge after the docs audit had to restore 24 files on next by hand. AGENTS.md and the next-behind-main issue text only cover conflicts ('next keeps its text'); they do not mention clean merges that delete.

Outcome: the person merging main into next is told which docs files the merge would delete from or shrink on next, and AGENTS.md says what to do.
